text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: One day, {0} accepted Satsuki's invitation and arrived a day early in the oni village to take part in their festival.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ある日、
{0}はサツキに招かれて、
お祭りに参加するために鬼族の村に前日入りしていた。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Quit sneaking around, brat Knight. Show yourself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……コソコソしてんじゃねェよ、
騎士公。
面ぁ見せな。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Don't take me for a fool. If you're gonna tail someone, at least learn to hide your damn presence.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ナメんな。
尾行ごっこがしたけりゃあ、
気配の一つも殺してきやがれ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Or what, brat Knight? Maybe you just love staring at my ass?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それとも騎士公。
手前──
俺のケツを眺めるのが好きだってか？

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Then, walk tall and keep up. Not like I'm hiding anything from you. I don't mind if you're near me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なら、
胸張って付いてきな。
別に隠し事
ってワケじゃねぇんだ。
騎士公がいようが
構やしねぇよ。

text_block_list.name: Little Girl's Ghost
text_block_list.text: Ugh... *sniff, sniff*...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ……
くすん、
くすん……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: It seems she's drifted over here recently. ...Her face bothered me a little... So I couldn't help but come to take a look.
text_block_list.orig_text:
最近ここらに流れ着いたらしい。
……
ちぃとばかり、
面差しが引っかかってな……
こうして様子を見にきてる。

text_block_list.name: Little Girl's Ghost
text_block_list.text: Flowers... Where are the flowers...? I want the kind of flowers that can make me happy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お花……
お花はどこ……？
幸せになれる、
お花がほしいの……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Flowers, huh? Must've been looking for them before she turned into a ghost. However, this is Gio Nivlhel. All the flowers are already withered.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……花か。
幽霊になっちまう前に、
探してたんだろうな。
だが、
ここはジオ・ニヴルヘルだ。
花は大抵枯れてる。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: No need to go through all that trouble. Once in a blue moon, a living flower drifts in. Right now, one of the oni happens to have one.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンな手間かける必要もねぇよ。
ごく稀にだが、
生きた花も流れ着く。
それが一輪だけ、
今ちょうど鬼族の手元にあってな。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: If I win tomorrow's festival bout, I'll get that flower as my prize. Not really my thing, so I'm going to give it to this runt.
text_block_list.orig_text:
明日の祭りの勝負で勝ちゃあ、
その生きた花を貰い受けることができる。
俺に似合う物でもねぇし、
こいつにくれてやるつもりだ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Not every oni's heartless enough to crush a kid's dream. Even in this Netherworld, good folk still exist.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ガキの石積みを崩す鬼ばっかじゃねェよ。
渡る世間になんとやら
ってな。

text_block_list.name: Little Girl's Ghost
text_block_list.text: Uu... uuu...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ……
うぅぅ……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: She's so tired from crying she made herself disappear... We should also head back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
泣き疲れて姿を隠したか……
俺たちも戻るとしようぜ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: You'd better show your face at the festival tomorrow, brat Knight. Oversleep, and I'll come drag you outta bed myself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
明日の祭りは、
手前も顔を出すんだぜ。
騎士公。
寝坊しゃあがったら、
叩き起こしてやっからな。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The next morning. The day of the festival.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そして翌朝。
お祭り当日。

text_block_list.name: Chieftain of the Oni Tribe
text_block_list.text: Listen to me, you lot! Today is the day of our long-awaited festival.
text_block_list.orig_text:
聞け、
野郎ども！
今日は待ちに待った祭りの日だ。

text_block_list.name: Chieftain of the Oni Tribe
text_block_list.text: There's no shortage of onifolk who've been training for this day. I hope every one of you gives it all you've got.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この日のために鍛えてきた連中も少なくないだろう。
思う存分、
みんなが実力を発揮できることを望む。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: With this Rock-Smashing Rite, we declare the festival open! ...SEIGH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この岩砕の儀をもって、
祭りの開会とする！
──せいッ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: CRACK!
text_block_list.orig_text: パッカーン！

text_block_list.name: Hyped Up Oni
text_block_list.text: WHOAAAA! She split the rock open with her bare hands!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うおおおおお！！
岩が素手で真っ二つだーッ！

text_block_list.name: Festival-loving Oni
text_block_list.text: As expected of Lady Satsuki. She split it so neatly... This year's festival is sure to be a great success!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さすがはサツキ様。
あれだけ奇麗に割れるなんて……
今年の祭りも
大成功間違いなしだな！

text_block_list.name: Oni Referee
text_block_list.text: Hakkeyoi... nokotta, nokotta, nokotta! ( TLNote: Sumo official referee chant )
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっけよい……
のこった
のこったのこったのこった！

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Oraaa!
text_block_list.orig_text: オラァッ！

text_block_list.name: Hyped Up Oni
text_block_list.text: OH! He's FLYING! Even higher than the roof!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお、
飛ばされたぞ！
屋根よりも高い！

text_block_list.name: Festival-loving Oni
text_block_list.text: This year's winning move ends up being a grab throw! As always, Lady Satsuki's spectacular sumo moves have captivated the entire audience!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今年の決まり手はつかみ投げかぁ！
相変わらずサツキ様の豪快な相撲は
魅せてくれるぜ！

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Brat Knight, you eaten yet? Skip a meal and you'll run outta steam. Our bodies are built differently.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士公よ。
メシ食ったか？　
食わねぇとバテるぞ。
俺と手前じゃ、
体のつくりが違ぇんだ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: But? ...Ah, so you're interested in the result of my grab throw.
text_block_list.orig_text:
けど？
……ああ、
あすこの弩が気になってるのか。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Don't worry about it. Think of it like a little test of courage.
text_block_list.orig_text:
気にすんな。
肝試しみてぇなもんだ。

text_block_list.name: Hyped Up Oni
text_block_list.text: Fear not, dear guest! Getting sent flying like that doesn't happen often! ...Well, except when it does.
text_block_list.orig_text:
心配することはない、
お客人！
吊るされて回転する弩なんて
そうそう当たりはしないからな！
……たまに当たるけど。

text_block_list.name: Festival-loving Oni
text_block_list.text: Exactly. A real man doesn't flinch at arrows that'll never hit. Eat, drink, laugh, and forget your worries! ...Though it does sting when one lands.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その通り。
当たりもしない矢を恐れるなど
益荒男にあらず！
気にせず食って飲んで
笑わなければな！
……当たると痛いけど。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Pipe down. A pheasant that keeps its beak shut doesn't get shot. Here, eat up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぴーぴー喚くな。
雉も鳴かずば撃たれねぇ
ってな。
ほら、
食った食った。

text_block_list.name: Hyped Up Oni
text_block_list.text: WHOOOOAAAA!! FORM UP... COMBINE!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うおおおおおッ！　
合体ッッ！！

text_block_list.name: Festival-loving Oni
text_block_list.text: IT'S A JOUSTING BATTLE!
text_block_list.orig_text: 騎馬戦だァ──ッ！！

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: I'm off for a bit.
text_block_list.orig_text: ちょっくら行ってくるぜ。

text_block_list.name: Hyped Up Oni
text_block_list.text: LOOK! Lady Satsuki is jumping from horse to horse, taking down foes one after another! This is her legendary Solo Eight-Horse Leap!
text_block_list.orig_text:
見ろ！　
サツキ様が騎馬から騎馬へと飛び乗り移って
次々と首級を挙げているぞ！
これぞサツキ様の
単騎・
八艘飛び！

text_block_list.name: Festival-loving Oni
text_block_list.text: Guess the festival's about done for the day... Hell of an event, though! Took an arrow to the knee, but I'll live! Hahaha!
text_block_list.orig_text:
祭りもそろそろ終わりか……
いや、
充実した内容だったな！
膝に矢を受けちまったが！　
はっはっは！

text_block_list.name: Hyped Up Oni
text_block_list.text: I'm sure Lady Satsuki will win again this time! Wahahahaha!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今回も優勝はサツキ様に違いないな！
わっはっはっはっは！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: *thud*!
text_block_list.orig_text: どんっ！

text_block_list.name: Tourist?
text_block_list.text: Ow, ow... how rude of me! I was looking the other way...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いたた、
これは失礼……
ちょっとよそ見していたもので……

text_block_list.name: Tourist?
text_block_list.text: Ah, how very polite of you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
これはどうもご丁寧に……

text_block_list.name: Tourist?
text_block_list.text: Heh, yeah, something like that... I really should be going, though. Sorry -- if you'll excuse me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はは、
そんなところです……
もっとも、
もう行かないといけないのですが……
……
すみません、
これで
失礼しますね。

text_block_list.text: Flowers... Where are the flowers...? I want the kind of flowers that can make me happy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お花……
お花はどこ……？
幸せになれる、
お花がほしいの……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, brat Knight? The closing ceremony is over, and I got my prize, a living flower.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どしたぃ、
騎士公。
こっちは閉会式も終わって、
賞品の生きた花も手に入ったぜ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Thanks. I'll give this to that ghostly pipsqueak tonight~
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんがとよ。
今夜にでも、
あの幽霊のチビにくれてやるとすっか──

text_block_list.name: Satsuki's Subordinate
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, Lady Satsuki! Someone's broken into our treasure vault. There are signs of a theft...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
サツキ様、
失礼しやす！
我らの宝物庫に何者かが侵入して盗みを働いた痕跡が……！

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Explain in detail.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ……？
詳しく聞かせな。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki's Subordinate
text_block_list.text: It seems that someone broke in when the festival left security thin. The item stolen was the "Spirit Orb of Resurrection"... It was probably the work of someone from outside Gio Nivlhel...
text_block_list.orig_text:
祭りで手薄になったところに侵入されたようです。
盗まれた物は『反魂の霊玉』……
おそらくは
ジオ・ニヴルヘルの外から来た者の犯行かと……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: The Spirit Orb... That thing that forcefully turns the dead into zombies, huh. Not exactly the sort of trinket people from Gio Nivlhel would risk picking a fight with us over.
text_block_list.orig_text:
霊玉……
死者を無理矢理ゾンビにするアレか。
ジオ・ニヴルヘルの連中が、
鬼にケンカ売ってまで
欲しがるようなモンでもねぇな。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki's Subordinate
text_block_list.text: Additionally, it's only a rumor... but lately there've been travelers from another world snooping around the village. Some folks say they saw one of them catching ghosts with a strange device.
text_block_list.orig_text:
加えて、
あくまで噂ですが……
ここ最近、
異世界の客が
村の周辺を探るように歩き回っていたそうで。
不思議な道具で
幽霊を捕まえているのを見た者もいるとか。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Tch. I was so caught up in the festival that I didn't notice. How careless...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……チ。
祭りにかまけて、
後手に回ったか。
不覚だぜ……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: What...? You ran into one of those tourists just now? And you even heard that ghostly girl's voice as he was making off?
text_block_list.orig_text:
何……？
その観光客に今さっきぶつかった？
しかも
去り際に例の幽霊っぽい声まで聞いただと？

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...They've got some nerve... Oi. Gather everyone who can still move. I'll track down this thief, even if it means chasing him down to the river of the dead itself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ナメた真似してくれるぜ……
おい。
動ける連中、
全員集めな。
三途の川の水を丸っと抜いてでも、
賊の行方を追ってやる。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: And before the post-festival feast even starts... I'll make him settle the score.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもって。
祭りの後の宴の前に──
落とし前をつけさせてやる。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The culprit stole the "Spirit Orb of Resurrection" together with a ghost. As a case that could develop into a major crisis, Satsuki is determined to settle it with her own hands.
text_block_list.orig_text:
幽霊とともに『反魂の霊玉』を盗み出した犯人。
大問題に発展しかねないこの事件を、
必ずや自身の手で決着させるとサツキは決意を固める。
